scope: Twenty scale-one synthetic pairs. Every pixel belongs to a region. Actions are supplied by the gallery caller and evaluated separately. Busy thresholds evaluate the recorded frame; rotation phase and motion remain unqualified.

rationale.surface: Exact except selected dark compositing, bounded to one channel unit.
rationale.edge: Exact, including focus outline; dark selected unfocused row allows one channel unit.
rationale.icon: Exact Source Lucide paths at 14px; only low-amplitude raster/color differences up to two channel units.
rationale.chevron: Separate 12px raster envelope, with tighter open/focused limits. Missing, displaced and wrongly mirrored closed glyphs must fail.
rationale.text: Separate short-label envelopes by appearance and selection. Missing and displaced text must fail independently of backgrounds.
rationale.actions: The actual caller's Source Lucide copy action at rest/focus. This proposal qualifies this fixture assembly only.
rationale.busy: Recorded 12px animated frame only. No motion or phase-parity claim. Missing and displaced indicator controls are measured.
